events.address: Central Baptist Church, 99 Narragansett Avenue, Jamestown, RI 02835
events.blurb: Songs associated with Frank Sinatra will take on a chamber-music sound when Lumos Experiences presents two candlelight performances at Central Baptist Church. Violinist Mina Lavcheva, violist Linda Numagami and cellist Zan Berry are scheduled to perform a program that includes Come Fly with Me, Strangers in the Night and the theme from New York, New York. The string-trio format puts the melodies in the hands of three instrumentalists, offering a different way to hear a repertoire familiar to generations of listeners. The setting adds a local connection to the evening: Central Baptist’s history reaches back to 1867, and the Jamestown Historical Society documented its anniversary with photographs, programs and other church memorabilia in 2017. Lumos, an outside concert organizer, is producing the event at the church. Each performance lasts one hour, and seating is assigned by ticket tier, with places within each zone taken in arrival order. The published minimum age is eight; ticket availability should be checked through the organizer. Doors: 5:15 p.m.. Ticketed; ages eight and older. Prices and seating tiers: lumos-experiences.com.
